notes.title: DARKEST DUNGEON UPDATE - BUILD: 25807
notes.content:
A new build has been deployed to retail! 

We have been working over the past several months to get a unified binary to all our storefronts. With this release, we're happy to report that EGS, GOG, and Steam are now all on the same binary and the 64bit has been released to all. 

We have added a new branch that is public for all to see on Steam called LEGACY, that is the build previous to the new version if you run into issues. That said it's nice to finally have all PC players on the same binary for all the amazing mods people have been working on.

notes.title: Darkest Dungeon II: Kingdoms Development Notes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome to Darkest Dungeon II: Kingdoms![/b][/h3]
This release is the result of a year-long grand experiment.

In December 2023, we were brainstorming about what interesting things we could add to Darkest Dungeon II. While new heroes and regions are always well received, we were feeling that familiar itch we got when planning out Darkest Dungeon I expansions. Namely, what if we did something…different? Something unexpected or…uncommon.  Something that would challenge us as developers, and surprise our players.

This creative impulse is the same one that led us to make the enormous Crimson Court, the endless Color of Madness mode, and the out-of-nowhere multiplayer arena of The Butcher’s Circus. It’s just part of our creative DNA to want to try experimental things - no two Red Hook releases have ever been the same, and we’re quite proud of that! In this crowded game market, wonderment is the only commodity that trades, and that’s not just true for players, but for developers as well. When we are inspired by what we’re building, we believe you’ll be inspired playing it. As our discussions took shape, we hit on 3 powerful ideas.

[b]#1: A Remix Album[/b]
We challenged ourselves to think about what we could do if we took all of the ingredients we had on hand with DDII and then added in some elements of DDI like persistent rosters and a larger self-contained campaign. In essence, we could remix our own game. “Who does that?” we mused.

What came out of this mental exercise was the core idea for Kingdoms: a board-game inspired strategy metagame that delivered a more persistent sense of space and time than the somewhat allegorical Confessions mode. Picking up the pieces of a ruined kingdom, defending it from attack - these were interesting concepts. Similar to a board game, we wanted to structure it with tons of replayability: multiple quests (the first of which launches Jan 27th), multiple maps, multiple customizable difficulty settings.

[b]#2: It’s Free[/b]
We’ve been fortunate that our hard work has found an audience. How best, then, to deploy this risky creative endeavor? A paid DLC would delight most boardrooms, but we felt that ultimately our fortunes rise and fall based on engagement. Players playing.  Having fun and getting wrecked. The ultimate aim of game development.  So, we asked, what if we just…gave it away? Yes, we’ll be drawing down on our war chest significantly, but perhaps we’ll attract new players, wishlists will convert, and word of mouth will buoy our sales.  This approach felt more honest, more authentic, and more in line with what we hope Kingdoms elicits in our fans.

[b]#3: And a DLC too, right? [/b]
So if Kingdoms is free, how do we cover some of our costs? Another DLC, released alongside, that integrates into both modes and provides more variety and challenge, is of course the answer.  But damn if that’s not hard to develop in tandem! Our team proved up to the task, however, and we’re thrilled with the results.

“[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3205310/Darkest_Dungeon_II_Inhuman_Bondage/]Inhuman Bondage[/url]” introduces an all new underground region (The Catacombs) and the return of one of DD1’s favorite heroes: The Abomination. One of the neatest parts of the DLC is that it adds content to both Confessions and Kingdoms game mode. Whichever one(s) you like, we have you covered. The existing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2598510/Darkest_Dungeon_II_The_Binding_Blade/]Binding Blade DLC[/url] works similarly–the character content in there will work in Kingdoms, too.

We’ve spent over a decade working on Darkest Dungeon. We’ve delighted in our explorations and iterations, and we’re nowhere near done.  On January 27th we invite you to experience the results of our latest experiment. If you already own DDII, you’ll get Kingdoms for free. If you are new to Darkest Dungeon II, you will find a complete game bundle is on sale at a hefty discount. Inhuman Bondage is also available on its own, modestly priced. Your purchases directly enable us to keep making these games..

There has never been a better time to board the stagecoach.

–Chris Bourassa & Tyler Sigman, Red Hook Studios

notes.title: Darkest Dungeon - Steam coming_in_hot Build #25869
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while! We wanted to let everyone know that we have just pushed a new build for [b]Darkest Dungeon to the coming_in_hot branch[/b]. The purpose of this build is to get us a step closer to releasing a unified binary to all our storefronts. Some of you may know that our GOG and Epic builds are [b][i]not[/i][/b] the same as what is available on Steam and this build is part of our effort to rectify that situation. This build does NOT contain any other fixes. 

We’ll keep this build up on the coming_in_hot branch for at least a few weeks to ensure stability. We have been testing many of the popular mods to ensure compatibility, but we want to give a period of time to soak test this new build and catch any issue we may have introduced. We would appreciate it if you could help test it out during that time to make sure everything works as intended. 

[b]Known Issue:[/b] If you are using Ubuntu and got your Steam client installed through "App Install" (also called SNAP), the game won't start.

To fix this, there are two possible solutions, but for both you will need to use terminal:

[b]Solution 1:[/b]
uninstall Steam from snap:
[list]
[*]sudo snap remove steam
[/list]
and then reinstall it with additional parameter:
[list]
[*] sudo snap install steam --classic
[/list]
[b]Solution 2:[/b]
Don't use the SNAP version of Steam (which is not made by Valve, but by Canonical) and instead download official version from https://store.steampowered.com/about/


Thank you for your help!

notes.title: Week 82: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”A sister of battle. Pious and unrelenting.”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]Mr Pepper’s Vestal Rework[/b][/u] by Mr.Pepper 

[i]This rework aims to make Vestal able to run different builds rather than the same 4 skills, whether it is range support or a more offensive role in the frontline.
Vestal’s base stats have not been changed, she however now has access to 2 new skills which replace Hands of Light and Illuminate; Banishment and Light’s Blessing. Divine Comfort is now limited use and gets refreshed between each wave in Endless.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1631983171025787429/4E93FD57355D6D56483F5FC4AAB534B7164A68A0/?imw=637&imh=358&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2618503297

[u][b]The Rudiment[/b][/u] by Lafos, ouroboros-art, CLeo1714

[i]The Rudiment is a man-made monster with a human’s soul, who almost lost all of its memories except for one, an old song. A warrior in life and a protector in death, the Rudiment is waiting for a chance to meet its Creator, its Father, whose voice summoned it to Hamlet. Maybe it’s to protect him as Rudiment… or as a human, to get revenge for its painful transformation. Because of its past, The Rudiment can still behave like any other humans, even though it sometimes leads to some… misunderstandings.
Depending on the task, the Rudiment can be a nice melee damage dealer or a great tank and supporter who is capable of protecting one ally during a whole battle and wreak havoc on the ranks of enemies. However, if the Rudiment is on guard, its strength is not the same as if its task is only to eliminate enemies. And remember, the Rudiment is still a monster and a huge threat, therefore it can also damage allies and put stress on them.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1633108875044603801/06F5A324104322997A83DDF67951C0941CAA3431/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

notes.title: Week 81: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”The cost of preparedness - measured now in gold, later in blood.”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]Casual Provisions and Common Enemies[/b][/u] by Kevkas

[i]Shows provisions suggestions on the right side of the expedition preparation screen based on a bunch of different guides/wikis and other mods.
This is for people who come back to the game every few months and can't remember how many of the provision items they should take with them.
Please - treat these values as a guide/suggestion, feel free to adjust the amount to your liking if you feel you're taking too much or too little with you.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1692776866646440061/02F90280797D538480A18B4768C2B799CA284115/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2129710534

[u][b]Mafe’s Vanilla Refactor: Hellion[/b][/u] by Mafe 

[i]This mod is aimed to bring a new breath to the Hellion class, based on Mafe's personal vision for her.

A) General aspects and mechanics:
-New Mechanic: Berserker Rage: When Hellion gets below 50% of her total life, she enters a state of pure rage where she deals and receives 20% more DMG. In this state, all of her skills get additional effects.
-However, after Hellion gets above 50% of her life again, she will hinder her rage and return to normal, with a 4 rounds and incurable -2 SPD and -20% healing received debuff.
-At combat's end, no matter health, she will return to her normal state without penalties.
-As a consequence of this, her entire skillset was revisited to fit this behaviour
-An unique Riposte that cannot miss or deal DMG but that buffs her allies
-New barks and some hidden references on those
-Lifesteal! After using Adrenaline Surge, all of her skills will heal her for a % of DMG done (on skill that deal DMG, of course)[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1671360457882677875/8D56EA81D472CDAB541A87B40D63E7A8C5EAB76C/?imw=637&imh=358&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img]

notes.title: Week 78: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”He will be laughing still... at the end.”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]Mr Pepper’s Jester Rework[/b][/u] by Mr.Pepper 

[i]This Rework aims to transform the rank 3 dependent Jester into a Dancer. He will bring support through buffs, debuffs and shuffles but is also a real offensive power!

Jester’s base stats have not been changed, but some of his gimmicks have been tweaked. Final buffs are now bigger (60% instead of 30%) but only last for 3 rounds instead of 7, this means this move should be considered even for non boss fights (especially since it stress heal allies on kill). Jester also now has a unique riposte that inflicts no damage, but buffs finale each time he is targeted. In endless all the battle limited skills refresh each wave.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1695031047317681322/103D2A96405A5827F007A2ACA80498A74C07AB6A/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2593110230

[u][b]Anemone’s Blighted Grave Robber[/b][/u] by Anemone, Adon 

[i]Anemone's Blighted Grave Robber: a mode-shifting rogue, building up for one grand attack, while decaying enemy ranks with an array of supportive ranged attacks!
If she is injured or at risk, she can force an ally to guard her and hide them from sight temporarily, giving both a chance to breathe!
And of course, she herself can fade from the frontlines to prepare an even stronger attack!
Using a reworked Toxin Trickery, that is a free action and usable three times a round, she can swap between her blighting Cloak mode, and her armor piercing Dagger mode!
Swap through modes with a stiff drink, to plan for the perfect attack. Distract your foes, fade out of sight, and get ready for the kill!
But beware! Too much of a good thing could have... long term effects.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1701786190916493015/DF98D38DCB1DF6E725B600DFE8B029D4457CD5DA/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

notes.title: Week 76 + 77: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”We fall so that we may learn to pick ourselves up once again.”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]The Shinobi[/b][/u] by Badger, ooh ah, Cat

[i]The Shinobi is a mobile damage dealer who is expert at stealth and applying status effects.
Coming with 10 trinkets of their own, they make a powerful ally.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1699533228840010953/3D3FCA831F040AE69D04FF6E39DCAA9E1EA32E5D/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2579320730

[u][b]The Meister[/b][/u] by EngineerBean, TrijE, ShallowIris

[i]"A marvel of technology!"

A weak boy at a glance, Meister is a master technician from the east. He was once a beloved retainer of the Emperor, but mysterious crews took everything from him. From the arcane relic of his country, his companions, to his majesty, his dearest friend. Instead of indulging on his blood-stained past, he stepped into the abyss to avenge the fallen ones, with only vendetta on his mind.

Meister destroys whatever stops him from his vengeance, using the mechanical beast made with his masterful craftsmanship. Moreover, he can support companions by spraying gunpowder to expose enemies to critical strikes, or utilize his prosthetic arm to stun them. Medicine is also not a field he lacks; his skill in acupuncture can revitalize even a hero on the verge of their demise.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1715295386025054530/4B244021434536D457A77DA8FBC9CF0362DB9F42/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2575427235

[u][b]Mafe Refactor for the Fanatic[/b][/u] by Mafe

[i]This mod reworks the fight of the Fanatic boss added with the Crimson Court DLC.
Changes:
-Fanatic is now always alone, as his Pyre was removed. His own custom audio stuff and his background got also removed.
-He now behaves like a Zealous Berserker: Forcing you to pick which heroes will be marked for Retribution, and fighting you with unmatched brutality the closer he is to death, and the more he gets hit.
-Fanatic no longer depends on Infestation level to spawn.
-Fanatic is eternal! Killing Countess wont stop him from showing with this mod enabled.
-On death, Fanatic may drop one of four new trinkets unique to him, plus some Crimson Court trinkets set.
-New skills and some hidden interactions has been given to him.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1692777722053252142/17764D081220F12E2E593C75A5E51F4471DA4A93/?imw=637&imh=358&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2578534507

[u][b]Ashen Warrior[/b][/u] by O'Nightmare!, LokiLaufey, Hooded_Lay

[i]Ashen Warrior class is based on Kratos from God of War series. Being experienced at wars he excels at dealing indirect damage and tanking. He offers a unique way of dealing damage via reflecting, transfering DoTs, AoE dmg on crits and just increasing damage with Enrage debuffs. Not to mention his insane survivability, thanks to high hp and strong heal.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/790877405127383289/A16434CAE71F22AA4BF96F93CA0C1A280629EE2F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

notes.title: Week 70 & 71: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Be wary - triumphant pride precipitates a dizzying fall...”[/i][/h3]


[u][b]Cho’s Garden Guardian Rework[/b][/u] by Chogex

[i]This mod’s aim has been to reduce the feeling of grind in the fight by allowing the player to deal more damage, while creating more opportunities for interesting decision making.

All of the Garden Guardian's parts have shared HP (like Flesh).
Shield takes little damage, Head is weak to direct damage and Arm is weak to DoT damage.

Most of the Garden Guardian's skills have had their damage, crit and acc lowered to account for the other changes that are listed in the full mod description.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1681492959795949061/8B5CD38D12500D5629D555E9C0E53ED9D2C080D0/?imw=637&imh=358&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2279459403

[u][b]Rotting King Leper Skin[/b][/u] by MoonKanin, NepNep

[i]This mod gives the Leper Class additional skins based around SPurple's Rotting King boss concept as well as color variants based on Gy's Rotting Cultist design.

Also supports the Butcher's Circus with custom death sprites added![/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1661231036573645995/FF016DE19B87653B09B23E4C80F2F170BEF5095E/?imw=637&imh=358&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2331903322

[u][b]Gemstar’s Cut: Shieldbreaker[/b][/u] by Uncanny Gemstar

[i]This Shieldbreaker rework is intended to be a general nerf and refocusing of the class. Shieldbreaker is known for being about to counter nearly every type of enemy, with multiple counters to prot, guard, high action economy, stealth, being shuffled and against rank specific enemies, and so forth.
This rework makes her much more heavily focused as anti-prot and anti-guard, stripping away unnecessary features in favor of making her a more specialized role instead of a generalist.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1751307208892503740/0983805B393E469DCD5C31BBDC98E95B720DAEAE/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2389950337

[u][b]The Bowman[/b][/u] by Cat, NBB, MetalGy, Shay, Uncanny Gemstar

[i]Those skilled with the bow will never go hungry.

The Bowman is a versatile ranged damage dealer. By default, all of his skills carry armor piercing. But with the skill “Change Arsenal”, he can freely toggle to instead inflict Bleed or Blight. He has various methods of dealing damage - high accuracy, high crit, or piercing arrows to spread status effects and damage. He also carries attacks that leave enemies crippled with powerful debuffs.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1696152519453463324/83BDA71B6BBE814427F9A0105A3E5789EA991222/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

notes.title: Week 68 & 69: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Steel yourself and remember: there can be no bravery without madness”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]The Sepulchre, Resurrected[/b][/u] by Cryptix

[i]A holy spirit trapped in runebound armor, or a mad wraith driven to consume souls? Only the ancestor knows the truth, and he's not talking. Nevertheless, armed with a Hand crafted harvester scythe and the powers of death itself, the Sepulchre seeks to purify its soul and release itself from its binding by collecting the souls of 70 upon 70 undead, trapped by eldritch machinations and forced to obey the whims of wicked men. The Sepulchre seeks to earn its penance, or die trying.[/i]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1701779934221001190/BBC3EB8991695E4C564DA4A4C96629249AEE25A1/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2525601290

[u][b]The Saw Hunter[/b][/u] by Crispy, Boldas

[i]"Transcend the hunt..."

The Saw Hunter is a new hero class inspired by the protagonist of Bloodborne, The Hunter. The Hunter wears a gray duster coat with a black bandana covering their face. Their weapons of choice are the Saw Cleaver and the Hunter's Pistol. At some point in their life, the Saw Hunter became afflicted with an unspecified disease, leading them to a town called Yharnam in search of a cure. In spite of their mysterious illness, the Saw Hunter is in fact much stronger and faster than average humans. They possess the strength and agility of a fearsome beast while resisting the call of blood-drunkenness through great force of will.[/i]

[h3][i]”Tortured and reclusive... this man is more dangerous than he seems...”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]Mr Pepper’s Abomination Rework[/b][/u] by Mr.Pepper 

[i]The main objective of this rework is to push Abomination to alternate between his forms depending on the fight, even rewarding transforming mid combat. notes.title: Week 64: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”She searches where others will not go... and sees what others will not see.”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]Mr Pepper’s Antiquarian Rework[/b][/u] by Mr.Pepper 

[i]This Rework aims to remove Antiquarian dodge cheese gimmick and instead solidify her in a support role, capable of acting like a solo healer. She mainly interacts with her own party, by curing negative effects, giving stealth, reshuffling other heroes or even buffing damage. She is also able to mess with the enemy party with shuffle and stumble, debuff or simply blights.

Since antiquarian will not be able to prevent as much dmg as she used to (through dodge buff and Acc debuff) she has been given a +5 dodge and +1 speed at every levels. This should help her to survive more easily despite having the lowest hp in the game and to outspeed her own teammates to make her support skills more valuable. Antiquarian’s passives have not been changed.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2499261641

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1760324221435903920/16EFDC20509ECF9D12EF49DBD780AFC31D7AB7CC/[/img]


[u][b]The Owlwing[/b][/u] by 54NBB, Sasiji, MetalGy, RefinedTurtleFlesh, Cat

[i]In recent days, after nightfall, there are several subdued criminals or their bodies at the entrance of the police station in town. A few frightened witnesses claim they saw a hybrid monster, both owl and human, that delivered these criminals...
A few days later, the “monster” found you on a fateful night - a man who said that his work coincided with your great cause, and that he was willing to join.

Owlwing is a Damage dealer used to hurting and finishing weakened or exposed enemies. He has the tools to inflict these debilitations by himself, as well as bonuses to fighting while stealthed. When out in the open, he can riposte as well.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2497069197

notes.content:
[h3][i]”Let me share with you the terrible wonders I have come to know...”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]The Esquire Class Conversion[/b][/u] by Roderick

[i]By popular vote, the Esquire has arrived at the Hamlet! Corrupted to his very core with the Crimson Court, he has come with an insatiable thirst for blood, and cares little as to where he gets it. With saber, smoothbore, and the monsterous form he keeps thinly veiled, he has plenty of reliable means to draw out his sustenance.

The Esquire is a highly mobile transformation class, that specializes in high damage and manipulating the enemies' movement.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2478154207

[u][b]The Magus[/b][/u] by Psyberry

[i]Hailing from a faraway City, the Magus has a strong connection to the planet. She can hear its whispers and tap into the dormant energy it provides.
Though she has a kind heart, her entanglement with the planet itself brought with it awareness—and at times corruption—as the planet itself suffered under the effect of the Heart of Darkness.

The Magus is a suitable support class with excellent diversity in the roles she can fill. As the quest goes on, she gathers more and more power with her Magna Vis ability. Keep in mind that massive/immediate healing is the only support role she may need some backup for.[/i]

[u][b]KCC’s Observer Trinkets[/b][/u] by Zifr

[i]Inspired by Anonymous_Koala’s idea, KCC's Observer Trinket Expansion (KOTX for short) gives you 15 more Observer rarity trinket base on each vanilla hero. You can get these trinkets from a certain otherworldly KCC miniboss…[/i]

notes.title: Week 61: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Gathered close in tenuous firelight, and uneasy companionship.”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]Cho’s Hero Reworks[/b][/u] by ショゲクス

[i]This is a collection of mods in a single mod that reworks every single hero in one big mod.

The main goal of each rework has been to bring skills within a hero's skillset closer together in power. Most used skills have seen nerfs and less used skills buffs and/or entire reworks.

Some of the more notable changes include:

* Antiquarian can't find antiques at lvl 5; instead her skills and stats gain significant buffs
* Big DoT skills have had their scaling changed from ~50% dmg increase to 100%, which is more in line with how small DoTs scale (1-3 vs 4-6 in vanilla reworked to 2-4 vs 4-8)
* Some Marks now tick down at the end of a round rather than each action
* Highwayman attacks twice each round
* Abomination works like all other heroes, no more transformation[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2481459771 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1803106735218917236/D2E78B10A187AA948EBD8087BF7C39A3C1A52C08/[/img]


[u][b]The Boatswain[/b][/u] by Reebalt

[i]"You cannot turn back time, but you can do your job better from here on out."

Boatswain demands the most out of his crewmates but gives twice as much in return. In spite of his harsh way of being, if you look close, you can still see sparks in the eyes of a man who went through more than anyone ever should.

Boatswain is a mobile, aggressive support class that specializes in shuffling the enemy team, making sure that the main damage dealers can deliver killing blows to the right targets.
He can also dish out damage on his own when situated in the front row as well as bolster a party's survivability via buffing and guarding.
His most powerful skills revolve around stressing the party out, thus consider bringing adequate trinkets or appropriate classes to fit his team.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2481566601 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1797477249068404094/23B3FC1E98E597120C2E21499AF57678F9D673D2/[/img]

notes.title: Week 55 & 56: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”A spark without kindling is a goal without hope.”[/i][/h3]

[u][b]Here Be Monsters[/b][/u] by Shay, Adon, Uncanny Gemstar, Moon Slime, Verywhale, Sasiji, Jens Sels, MetalGy, Zap, MoonKanin, Wellington McSkellington, TrueLolzor, Sketch, terkmc, Mhnlo, PhallseAnghell, Kenthril, Slightly Seal, 54NBB, Methusiel, DCR, Alpaca

[i]"In coming to these blighted, perditious lands, you are no longer in the realm of the familiar. Ghouls and fiends of every conceivable form skulk and chitter in every shadow, ensnaring the bravest of men and breaking them over their knees into wailing madmen. Our troops may prepare, but they will never be truly ready to face the crawling terrors that plague our estate. You are off the edge of the map, and here be monsters..."

Here Be Monsters is a series of mods that will add dozens of new enemies and trinkets to Darkest Dungeon. This is an ongoing project that will periodically update as new enemies are released. The enemies have varied mechanics and diverse movesets that bring added challenge to your game. Each enemy included in the mod includes at least one rare trinket that they may leave on death, with minibosses having more. 14 enemies are currently included in the mod, with many more well on the way![/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2433996706

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1736674500824400852/6C68B29E67606D6F0F5D8CE3EB47AD822742CE53/[/img]


[u][b]Female Abomination Skin[/b][/u] by Dinosaur Nerd

[i]This is pretty simply an abomination skin that allows for equal opportunity employment
for she-beasts seeking to earn gold and glory in the darkest hamlet alongside other
brave adventurers! This does not alter gameplay in any way, and is simply artwork.

I created this to practice my own artwork and try to improve shading in particular,
though I also wanted to practice some anatomy and such. It was quite a task to try
to mimic the red hook style of artwork, and hopefully this captures the right aesthetic.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2429782241

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1738925904394233459/D58CEF83DBC12DE58F2D68ACD3C072FD956E2858/[/img]


[u][b]The Baron Class Conversion[/b][/u] by Roderick

[i]Having grown tired of the usual audience within his own court, the Baron has departed from the swarms of corrupted nobles, and arrived at the Hamlet, bringing with him his latest dramas and sadistic games.

This mod takes the Baron boss from the Crimson Court, and converts them into a fully playable hero class you can pick up from your stagecoach. The Baron is a mid-rank support that can be built to either debilitate your enemies, or provide risky, but rewarding buffs to your allies. Or a mix of both.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2445871830

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1718660999256569353/51EA6C5C7EFDF3CB585E2DEAC780D6877AC830F2/[/img]


[u][b]The Orphaned Thief[/b][/u] by Blue Skies Above

[i]“A lost child, whose resourcefulness and cunning have made sure that she is still alive to this day. She carries the likeness of devilkin and the marks of traumas past.

She has no memories of the place she is from, but boasts an uncanny knack for skulking around unseen. Wanted by no one and with no place of belonging, she wanders the land begging and stealing to survive, stumbling upon this cursed land by accident. Don’t let her young age fool you, she is more dangerous than she looks.”

The Orphaned Thief functions much the same as a Grave Robber, dancing back with stealth and lunging forward for massive damage. She comes equipped with a few new skills and can debuff enemies with her spectral cat.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2442033354

notes.title: Week 53 & 54: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Many fall in the face of chaos; but not this one, not today.”[/i][/h3]

Apologies on the brief hiatus. Mod Showcases are now back; here are the mod showcases for week 53 and 54! 

[u][b]The Corsair[/b][/u] by Shay, EbonyBetty, Anonymous_Koala, Adon, Kaxen6, Cat, FlissyFox

[i]The Corsair is an all new class mod for Darkest Dungeon. An infamous pirate warlord, the Corsair has arrived to expand her criminal empire and claim whatever riches may lie here. She is a nimble and powerful damage dealer, with a variety of exotic weapons and tactics at her disposal allowing her to inflict devastating damage and bleeds. She compensates this by being rather frail, having a relatively low HP pool. She has fully original assets, including sprites, animations, and sounds.

"The notorious Corsair is a terrifying combatant, dancing between enemy blades untouched and lashing out from the shadows. She dashes across the battlefield like a ghost, setting herself up to inflict devastating damage with her arsenal, disrupting and weakening her opponents to her deadly blows!"[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2363386707

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1773823094730405310/071E5AB00053394416F26C182AD1A2900022A28B/[/img]


[u][b]The Templar[/b][/u] by Caedwyn and Seal

[i]The Templar is a warrior-bishop who has returned to the Hamlet from resisting the pagans. He stands as a wall of faithful steel, defending his comrades with body and spirit. Through devout faith, he works minor miracles upon his allies. To his enemies, he retaliates with extreme force.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2414180617

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1754687357124237659/34118D7BBADCC92CE7C7CE3A4D50FCB699F16F97/[/img]


[u][b]The Illuminator[/b][/u] by Roult, MoldyMrWaffles, Eittienne

[i]The Illuminator is a mid to frontline warrior/support. Some of his moves are powerful but melt his hp in higher amounts of light while others do different things depending on the light level. Calling upon the light he can use a powerful & cleansing self heal at the cost of stunning himself. When camping he can comfort the party and himself as well as produce more Prayer Candles that buff a singular hero for a battle.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2419040138

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1769324209270686404/9A5BEEF619858ED50763A555BF1476D1EA0E4863/[/img]


[u][b]The Golem[/b][/u] by Ooh Ah, S-Purple, Uncanny Gemstar

[i]"A hulking juggernaut from beyond the stars, ready to fight. The golem wields the ancient armor of a long dead hero to terrifying results, able to destroy any enemy in her path with splintering strikes and able to shake off even the mightiest of blows with her bulky armor."

The Golem is a front line self sustaining tank. Because of her strange biology the Golem is immune to diseases, has a high resistance to blight and bleed, but will receive no healing from any source other than her own abilities. This comes in form of her innate disease, that will be applied the first time Golem uses any move and cannot be gotten rid of afterwards, Metal Body.[/i]

[h3][i]A spark without kindling is a goal without hope.[/i][/h3]

Here are this weeks mods:

[u][b]Community Dialogue Project[/b][/u] by Ergo, Dead Iverson

[i]This mod works on adding many hero barks to the game for all heroes in the game, in many scenarios. While it is a work in progress, there is a link in the mod description for anyone to submit ideas for lines of their own, allowing people to work together to work on the mod.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2289721175

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1647717313597844679/A5201C99AE680ADB42DFD8226C93E2969B8990D8/[/img]


[u][b]The Anointed[/b][/u] by Retrograded, Falco, Shay, Kenthril

[i]"Feathered, fanatical, but most of all faithful, the Anointed utilises powerful miracles and buffs to enliven and inspire his allies. However, he is not loathe to go on the offensive, striking with holy fervour and flinging zealous accusations."

The Anointed is a brand new class mod for Darkest Dungeon. A wildly fanatical bird man, he is religious hero who channels his devotion into respectable heals, damage, and debuffs, and has arrived at the Hamlet with the simple purpose of purging it of evil.

The Anointed comes with original artwork, sounds, and animations, and fully custom barks for reactions to the many things in and outside the dungeon![/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2378584809

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1763691294088793926/4A06B10576DC14DA306001C10344529B7E034D62/[/img]

notes.title: Week 47: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]Remind yourself that overconfidence is a slow and insidious killer.[/i][/h3]

Here are this weeks mods:

[u][b]The Stargazer[/b][/u] by Shay, Arcapepper, JolBalrok, Adon, Cat

[i]"The space between worlds is no place for mortal men..."

The Stargazer is an all new class mod for Darkest Dungeon. He is a frail but powerful damage dealer, an astronomer who has been touched by an unfathomable astral force, granting him abilities that can only be described as magic. By tapping into this force, he opens himself to phenomenal cosmic power, which can possess him, body and soul, tearing away at his psyche. As a result, one is never fully in control of the Stargazer's actions, and if pushed too far, he may lose control. He has fully original assets, including sprites, animations, and sounds.

"Imbued with cosmic forces beyond his comprehension, the Stargazer bends space and time to his will, flinging his enemies across the battlefield with volatile energy some would call magic. His true strength is beyond his understanding, however, and he is never fully in control of his own actions."[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2363387321

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1773823094730387498/6594EA934BC5D908D8E56CAABB1D2078A5CE4E3F/[/img]


[u][b]Dragon’s Duelist[/b][/u] by dragon, 54NBB, Dismas 

[i]“Inadequacy gives birth to aspiration- and desperate longing.”

The Duelist is a high dodge low hp frontliner. She specializes in movement skills, debuffs, and consistent damage- and has riposte and guard to back her up. She is weak to dots and her resistances are fairly low- especially her deathblow resist.
Keep her hp high or you could lose her in an instant![/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2371334111

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1767068369294489186/8C19FC130B2D7723EA8B8809BB6F7C79CE3898D1/[/img]

notes.title: Week 43 & 44: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]The sin is not in being outmatched, but in failing to recognize it.[/i][/h3]

Happy New Year! Here are this weeks and last weeks mods:

[u][b]Shadow of the White Vvulf[/b][/u] by ooh ah, TerkMC, Woona, BattedMH(NS) , BEAN CONSUMER

[i]"Though the pack is dispersed, mourn not for it's leader. For the spirit of the hunt never stays dead for long."

The White Vvulf is a Darkest (Lv 6.) Bossfight that takes place in the Farmstead. This boss fight will test your mettle, you will most likely not succeed on your first attempt. There is no punishment for retreating during this fight. It is highly recommend to bring a hero with a stun ability.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2323183876

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1663482127950794328/8133A2F39B4139F474D2A3D9EFBEC029E7886B54/[/img]



[u][b]The Exterminator[/b][/u] by Comrade, Snorlaxxo, 54NBB  

[i]A professional in disease control and prevention, the Exterminator was summoned to the Hamlet to take care of a seemingly mundane rat infestation, only to find that the corruption in the sewer reaches far beyond the material plane. Bounded by contract and his own code of duty, the Exterminator is here to stay until the root of the infestation has been removed and the ground cleansed of its remains.

The Exterminator is a mid rank offensive support with a niche of anti DoT and disease, being able to ward his entire team with great resistance while disrupting the enemy with a variety of debuff, disruption and stun. Though his direct damage isn’t great, over time, the accumulated blight damage of his fumigator can wear down an entire team at once, and the weakened can be finished off with a stomp of gun stock.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2336153147

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1655601720509319981/752F59665579DD661DC4555C938F00F154D42D28/[/img]


[u][b]Diseasy Does It[/b][/u] by Dies Horribly

[i]As it turns out, while you and your loyal band of doomed adventurers were toiling for the sake of the Hamlet, an infinitesimal evil was brewing under your feet. Pestilence and malaise have always been a perilous aspect of this hard-knock life we live, so it was only a matter of time before unfamiliar plagues from forgotten corners of the land swept through our beleaguered community.

This gameplay mod adds 1 new quirk, as well as 20 new diseases for your unfortunate heroes to catch sick with. It also enables Sky Taint to be contracted by random means. The diseases I added are intended to mesh elegantly with the ones already present, while also spicing up both the variety and the danger of encountering illness.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2342665064

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1663483461679937602/0B85856E73FA374EFB8B73AAEE818A13E87AFFFB/[/img]


[u][b]Vinny’s Blackest Enemy Overhaul[/b][/u] by vinnyp316, Cryptix, Chassé, 54NBB, Woona

[i]After countless cycles of bloodshed and death, the heart of the world has been corrupted beyond any sane human’s wildest imaginations. The types of these creatures have morphed, planting and harvesting core components of their being. The brains of these creatures have been lobotomized and refashioned, giving them intelligence far beyond what was once had. And of most import, the flesh and soul of many of the strongest creatures on this plane have been shifted, giving them powers beyond compare, and taking away just as much. It is time for the true test of mettle, the final cycle. Welcome... to the Blackest Overhaul.

Every boss in the game has been tweaked, every enemy slid in a more interesting direction, and moves of these foul creatures have been given a tune up. The changes are so numerous it would be impossible for them to go over everything, so make sure to check the full mod page![/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2332466614

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1644342492739665916/3C5D26EA4B9F6B01E155D2BE5BCADAD9F0F60427/[/img]



Thank you creators for their hard work and talent and thank you to our fans for your dedication and continued support! We love and highly appreciate you!

If you would like to suggest mods for us to showcase, you can join our Discord here and message our moderator LolExxDee:

http://discord.gg/darkestdungeon

notes.title: Week 42: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Many fall in the face of chaos; but not this one, not today.”[/i][/h3]

Here are this weeks mods:

[u][b]The Chaplain[/b][/u] by Badger

[i]The Chaplain is a flexible fighter who excels at both support and offense. Her diverse training grants her a choice between a selection of attacks to bear on enemies, or to leverage powerful buffs to aid allies in battle.

She comes with 11 class trinkets that will support her resolve in aiding you in this terrible quest.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2321328188

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1662356138343977354/85157A124F4F3F14A010C3D6E8B78DF505AFD29B/[/img]



[u][b]The Ringmaster[/b][/u] by TheHolyChicken, Anonymous_Koala, Chassé , Shay, Zap 

[i]"The Ringmaster demands a challenger!"

Charismatic. Enigmatic. Barbaric. The Ringmaster leads The Butcher's Circus with a gleeful grin and an iron fist, with her unique set of skills able to delight and dismay in equal measure. Many have tried to usurp her, and none have lived long enough to regret it - much to the glee of the bloodthirsty rabble.

The Ringmaster is a versatile and dynamic addition to any party, comfortable anywhere on the battlefield. She can bestow buffs upon her allies, or rain down blows upon her foes, all while entertaining the crowd and everyone around her.
  - All skills uniquely animated and with original sounds
  - Custom virtue & affliction! You won't like her when she's angry...
  - Adds an evolving quirk for fame-seekers who crave the spotlight
  - 9 new trinkets, and single-player variants of all 103 Butcher's Circus PvP trinkets!
  - Town events with hamlet sprites and ancestor voiceover

notes.title: Week 36 & 37: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Madness - sublimity of the intelligence, or so it has been said.”[/i][/h3]

Here are this weeks and last weeks mods:

[u][b]Dr Feelgood Roaming Miniboss[/b][/u] by Cryptix

[i]Beware when the Good Doctor comes to town.
Peddling his wares exotic and proud.
He brings nothing but death and misery in his wake.
For every gift he grants, another soul he takes."
Dr Feelgood will begin to roam the hamlet much like the Thing after the first expedition to the Farmstead.
Fear the good Doctor![/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2273705705

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1687121982050845494/F69F869E3395EBE1DBFFC31DB11637A1FC357E5E/[/img]



[u][b]Farmstead+[/b][/u] by Hunting Slime, Anonymous Koala, Shay 

[i]Farmstead+ is designed to be an overhaul of the Color of madness DLC. It's main focus is to add onto the DLC, while trying to keep the base feel and flow of the DLC there.
This adds new types of quests to the Farmstead, including Explore, Slay, Gather, and Boss missions. Farmstead+ even has two Darkest level bosses, if you’re feeling brave…[/i]


https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2271257412

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1685995847737980477/7BFDE49C159B25CC17BE12E9B5A56E2E8729FAAF/[/img]



[u][b]New Extra Abilities for Heroes:[/b][/u] by verywhale, MetalGy, 54NBB


[i]This mod adds two new joke skills to Leper, Jester, Plague Doctor, Highwayman, and Antiquarian, all with their very own art and animations with more coming in later updates. Alongside this, it modifies the guild and character panels to make sure that everything can fit these new abilities.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2198053581

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1661224360654446943/9B546B884E6E1C018B664DE990D27B0F88925873/[/img]



[u][b]The Practitioner[/b][/u] by Seal, Shay, Anonymous Koala, Jezamine Tan

[i]The Practitioner comes from the distant Sunward Isles. Once a prevalent member of the Sunward aristocracy, he lost his seat in the court in a magical duel with a rival onmyoji. After a failed plot of revenge against his rival, he was cursed with the appearance of a koi.

The Practitioner is a bit of a mix between an Antiquarian and an Occultist, being able to provide support from the mid ranks, while also being able to find artifacts that both bolster his skills and provide gold.[/i]

notes.title: Week 30: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Prodigious size alone does not dissuade the sharpened blade.”[/i][/h3]

Here are this weeks mods:

[u][b]The Gallows Tree[/b][/u] by Shay, GoblinMan Is Cool, Adon, Dragonborn, TrueLolzor

[i]Here Be Monsters is a series of mods that will add new enemies to Darkest Dungeon. This second installment introduces the Gallows Tree, a corrupted tree that can be found in the depths of the Weald. Long reviled by the Hamlet for its gruesome decades-long history, the Tree has taken on new life under the fell magic that has twisted the lands. Twice cursed and bearing hatred for all that is good, its corruption is sure to strangle all forms of life that venture near it...[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2121063677

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1054352812470332421/F1F90AB278BAAA212253F3F072D34BC74FBE197E/[/img]



[u][b]The Mender[/b][/u] by A Guy Named Guy

[i]This mod adds a brand new Hero to the Darkest Dungeon, called the Mender. She is a support-based hero that specializes in healing, able restore ally health and stress, curing all DoTs and debuffs, a stun skill, a damage skill that applies blight, and an enemy mark skill.

The Mender also fulfills a special role at camp revolving around curing lasting and healing the injured. She can cure the entire party of Mortality Debuffs and cure everyone of Disease. She can also prevent nighttime ambushes, heal everyone of some stress, and has an improved variant of the First Aid skill that heals twice and can be used 3 times per camp.[/i]

notes.title: Week 28: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Where there is no peril in the task, there can be no glory in its accomplishment.”[/i][/h3]

Here are this weeks mods:

[u][b]The Salamander[/b][/u] by Shay, TerkMC, Adon, Kenthril, PhallseAnghell, Rakked 

[i]"A marvel of technology! An engine of destruction!"

The Salamander is an all new class mod for Darkest Dungeon based on an original design by S-Purple. An accomplished mercenary from a distant land who has specialized in bodily modification, the Salamander is a nimble but fragile damage dealer, featuring powerful attacks, shuffles, and bleeds. Her powerful flame abilities come with a risk of backfiring on her, damaging her frail body beneath her armor. She has fully original assets, including sprites, animations, and sounds.

"A grim fusion of metal and flesh, the Salamander has become a living war machine. Through use of her flamethrower, she can inflict devastating albeit unstable area attacks on her enemies, or nimbly jump to and fro with her prosthetic claws, wreaking havoc on the enemy's formation!"
[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2204287440

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1501341935247802867/E678D6B45CF7206709775A91DF3F13768C6D610C/[/img]


[u][b]The Carnifex[/b][/u] by Cryptix, 54NBB 

[i]"A beast stalks these once-hallowed graves, draped in the flesh of a dead man and hungering for the souls of the long-departed."

The Carnifex is attracted by the stench of the dead, returning from the graveyard as more of your heroes die. Similarly to Vvulf, the Carnifex will wait until you have a full party ready for him once his conditions have been met, with the Apprentice version requiring Lvl 1 Heroes, the Veteran requiring Lvl 3 Heroes, and the Champion requiring Lvl 5 Heroes. Similarly to the Crimson Court introduction event, refusing to fight the Carnifex will lead to the entire Abbey closing its doors until he has been defeated.[/i]


https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2226318273

notes.title: Darkest Dungeon - Steam Build #25622
notes.content:
Mac and Linux support is finally here for The Butcher's Circus! We are also adding various other improvements Good luck to all in Season 2! 

[b]The Butcher’s Circus[/b]
[list]
[*] Mac and Linux support has been added!
[*] Various small polish items on the Circus screens.
[*] Offline Mode - You can now practice against a local bot file that can be edited. While offline and fighting those practice bots you will not be able to earn prestige. You can still earn prestige from facing Bots in the matchmaking queue if you fail to find a human opponent.
[*] Added Steam rich presence when in the Circus
[*] Added text on the rewards screen, when player has max prestige, to indicate prestige cannot be increased.
[*] [b]Direct Challenge Improvements![/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve updated the Direct Challenge screen to support challenging someone who is not on your friends list. It involves a few steps, but is straightforward.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/23d00df8d2433b6cc907f8d9310d0b75b35f6016.png[/img]
[olist]
[*]On this screen you will see your ID listed at the bottom. Copy that ID and send it to the person you are looking to challenge.
[*] They paste the ID into the top field. Once this is done a Lobby ID will appear. They copy that Lobby ID and send it back to you. 
[*] You paste that Lobby ID in and then you both can join the match. 
[/olist]
[*] Fixed a game crashes due banner caching
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing users to see ‘Connection Error’ and would prevent them from entering matchmaking.
[*] Fixed a crash with the character sheet being open on-death in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ancestor's Memoirs statue always displayed its initial broken-down sprite

notes.title: The Butcher’s Circus – Season 2 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Circus-goers![/h3] 

The release of the Butcher’s Circus is a month behind us, so we wanted to give an update on what’s coming up next for the DLC as well as details on how the Circus Seasons will play out. We are hoping to have this patch ready within the next couple of weeks, and we will have more specific dates once we have a release candidate containing all of these changes.  

[b]Season Structure[/b]

Since launch, we’ve been planning on adding a Season structure to the ladder to help keep the competition fresh. [b]The next season will start when this patch is released, which we hope will be in the next week or so.[/b] Once we have a confirmed date we will announce it here again as well on social media and our discord! 

Here are the specifics of how the Seasons will operate moving forward: 

[list]
[*] Each season in the Circus will last 6 weeks. During this time, players will have the time to climb the ranks to the Darkest League. At the end of the season, participating players will unlock pieces of an exclusive banner for that season. There will be one piece per league, and a player who achieves a higher league will earn all pieces from lower leagues.
[*] After the season, each player’s rank will decay based on the highest achieved rank in the preceding season. For instance, a player who reached Darkest League Tier I may now be in Veteran League Tier I (the exact decay may change from season to season depending on how many players reach each tier).
[*] The season rollover will also give us an opportunity to introduce potential balancing changes in the event that the metagame needs a shakeup.
[/list]

Here is a list of the other new features coming the The Butcher’s Circus with the next update:

[list]
[*] [b]New Banner[/b]
         In addition to the Season banners discussed above, we also created a new banner as a gift to 
         everyone for bearing with us through all the desyncs we hit during the release window of the 
         DLC. 
[*] [b]Party Builder[/b]
         A common quality of life feature requested since release was the ability to save party presets to 
         make it easier to mix up your strategies and experiment with different builds. Coming in the next 
         patch you can now save up to 5 predefined parties. These saved parties will retain their skill and 
         equipped trinkets and can be customly named. 
[*] [b]Controller Support[/b]
         For all of those that use the gamepad to play the base game, you can now enjoy the Circus 
         without having to swap back to the mouse and keyboard! 
[/list]

[b]What’s next after this release? [/b]

After this patch we have a few more items we would like to action. 

[b]Mac/Linux Support! [/b]

The Mac and Linux builds are so close to being ready for release! We need just a little bit longer to test and ensure they are fit for the wide release. So while they won’t be in this next patch, they will follow very soon after. 

[b]Offline Mode and Better Bots[/b]

We want to allow users to access the DLC while offline so those who are doing the campaign and see the Town Event but don’t have an internet connection (or perhaps don’t want to face another human user) can still complete the event by facing a team of BOTS.

We also want to improve the BOTS so that they present a little more challenge as well as give our modders access to them in some capacity to allow for custom BOTs to be shared around the community.

[b]Connection Code[/b]

Last but definitely not least, we want to continue to improve the connection code. Since release we have made great strides towards a more stable environment. We still have some work to do in this effort. While this change might not be the flashiest, it will help set up the DLC in a great position for longevity as the Seasons progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7434629/37bf9eb5b9df97597b63a9d0da560039aa80a314.png[/img]

https://www.darkestdungeon.com/the-butchers-circus-season-2-update/

notes.title: Darkest Dungeon - coming_in_hot Build #25521
notes.content:
Greetings Hamlet Dwellers! 

In preperation for the release for the DLC tomorrow we are pushing a base game build to our coming_in_hot public beta branch for players to help us test for any issues with the base game. Below are the patch notes for what has change in the base game since our last patch.

[h1]Darkest Dungeon [/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW TOWN EVENT[/b]
[list][*] Added two new town events that relieve stress for the entire hamlet roster if at least one circus match is played before beginning the next week.[/list]
[*] Fixed positioning changes caused by AoE knockback and pull abilities
[*] Added stress heal received while camping buff to Meditator quirk
[*] Stress modifier vs [Enemy Type] buffs are now active while that enemy type is present in the combat. (Such as Fear/Hatred/Phobia quirks)
[*] Lowered Bloodmoon Radiant Light Dodge bonus to match Stygian (2.5%) instead of Radiant (7.5%)
[*] Plow Horse Color of Madness enemy won’t cause stall-related crashes when modded into non-wave combats
[*] Fixed enemy reinforcements crash in Darkest Dungeon location
[*] Fixed Abomination being able to ignore allies’ move-block actouts
[*] Added option to opt out of data collection
[*] Supports both new and old localization formats
[/list]

[b]Modding[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]NEW DUNGEON RULES[/b]
[list][*] Added  "dots_can_deathblow". When false, bleed and blight no longer causes heroes to roll a death’s door check.
[*] Added “deaths_door_test_survived_resistance_chance” to dungeon rules. A hero’s deathblow resistance is reduced by this amount each time they survive a death’s door check, cumulatively.[/list]
[*] [b]NEW TRINKET EFFECT TRIGGERS[/b]
[list][*] Added "melee_attack_skill" effect trigger for trinkets
[*] Added "ranged_attack_skill" effect trigger for trinkets
[*] Added  "riposte_attack_skill" effect trigger for trinkets
[*] Added  "attack_crit" effect trigger for trinkets[/list]
[*] [b]NEW BUFF RULES[/b]
[list][*] Buffs can now be conditional on actorStatus "virtued" and "afflicted" 
[*] Buffs can now be conditional on rule_type "activated_first " and "activated_last " 
[*] Buffs can now decrement at the end of rounds rather than the end of an actor’s turn by using .buff_duration_type  "after_turn" and "after_round"[/list]
[*] [b]NEW SKILL RULES[/b]
[list][*] Combat skills with “.ignore_deathsdoor true” will deathblow instantly if they deal lethal damage, regardless of deathblow resist. The target will be killed even if it was not already on death’s door.[/list]
[*] [b]NEW STATS[/b]
[list][*] Added “deathblow_chance” which increases the chance of deathblow and is applied against deathblow resistance.
[*] Added “heartattack_stress_heal_percent” which modifies the amount that stress is lowered after suffering a heart attack.
[*] Added “buff_duration_percent” which increases the duration of buffs applied by the hero
[*] Added “ignore_guard” which causes skills to bypass guard.[/list]
[/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
Some Localization Strings are still missing for some languages. These will be corrected when we push the DLC.

notes.title: Week 11: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]”Be wary - triumphant pride precipitates a dizzying fall...”[/i][/h3]

Here are this weeks mods:

[u][b]The Bloodclot[/b][/u] by Uncanny Gemstar

[i]The Bloodclot is a highly variable and self sufficient hero. From the front, he savages enemies at close range. He pierces shell, bone, and armor alike with vampiric fangs that ravage those weakened by blight and bleed. He rips and consumes his foes flesh with mutated flesh that hungers for blood to sustain himself. With the strength granted by his curse, he tears targets to pieces with his claws, heightening his frenzied ability to consume his enemies. In the back rows, he rains hell down on the battlefield, no shuffling mosquito or retreating cultist able to escape him. He lobs balls of his own cursed festering blood at foes, opening their own wounds, or sprays accumulated bile to clear his thoughts. His most dangerous ability is utilized through Litmus, drowning the enemies in the very malignancies they inflict upon him. His body is ravenous and bottomless, and can consume the suffering of his allies, curing them of their ailments while bringing out his own.
[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2060478391

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1001430772863248941/D2EE9C015B14948FB8C148802D56ED3C1F20FB65/[/img]




[u][b]Doomsday - Miniboss Mod[/b][/u] by Dem and Adon

[i]Fight a terrifying new menace. Encounter Doomsday, a new monster in three new challenging dungeon encounters! If you can defeat this powerful creature, you have a chance to earn crystal shards, rare trinkets, or new quirks that may help you in your Color of Madness adventures. Will you be able to defeat him before your heroes meet their doom?

In addition to new dungeons, there is a small random chance to encounter Doomsday in the Endless Harvest Quest or in LVL 2, 3, 4, or 5 Dungeons in the Weald, Cove or Sunward Isles (Optional Mod). Random encounters do NOT occur in the Ruins, Warrens or Crimson Court. You will see a visual indicator that means there is a 25% CHANCE at the encounter in that area.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1889221242 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/766100671609216475/DA5C6CD702018DB11A8F0E748B15BCC0B15914BC/[/img]

[h3][i]”Compassion is a rarity in the fevered pitch of battle.”[/i][/h3]
Here are this weeks mods:


[u][b]The Privateer[/b][/u] by DapperJack

[i]Having lost his ship and crew to the malevolent seas by the Manor, this shantyman has washed ashore in search of vengeance. With fiddle in one hand and a bottle o' grog in the other, the Privateer aims to venture into the Darkest of Dungeons.

This all new class mod comes with 5 skins, 7 unique abilities, 3 unique camping skills, 10 class trinkets, customized effects, a town event, and much more!

The Privateer is a mid-row support and stress healer who can be played in a number of ways.
Put him in the front ranks and down some rum to make your Privateer a heavy hitting damage dealer, or throw him in the back ranks to heal stress and wounds alike![/i]

He has a unique rejuvenating hypnosis technique that can cleanse "battle-limited" skills from a teammate. In addition, the hounds can help with attacks, counter attacks, and bleeds. notes.title: Week 4: Mod Showcase

[h3][i]”A moment of clarity in the eye of the storm..."[/i][/h3]

[h3]Here are this weeks mods:[/h3]

[u][b]The Windcaller[/b][/u] by Power

[i]The Windcaller is a Buff/Debuff focused Support Hero, built around Pushing and Pulling both friend and foe alike. With strong gusts of wind she can disrupt enemy positioning, weakening them in the process and leaving them vulnerable. Should your opponents do the same, she can simply Slingshot your heroes to the frontline, or Whisk them away To Safety in the backline. If your team can handle it, she can also grant a huge buff to Dodge, Speed, and Crit chance, at the cost of Shuffling your entire party in a Wild Whirlwind.

She works well in stationary teams with fixed positioning, able to easily reposition heroes back in their proper locations should they be shuffled or moved. But she also works wonders in teams built around dancing and moving around, taking advantage of strong buffs and offering a unique party-wide shuffle to buff up your heroes. Whether it's keeping a Leper firmly planted in the frontline with Storming Slingshot, or shuffling your Grave Robber around to spam Lunge, she's got plenty to offer to any team while avoiding overstepping onto the roles of vanilla characters.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1751539235

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/787480069422775146/2C8935DCD6D90A938CF63C02843C4EA13A308FC1/[/img]

[i]The Alchemist is a group project mod that adds a brand new hero to Darkest Dungeon. This hero is completely custom, with all new sprites, skills, sounds, and animations, as well as a complete set of unique trinkets and color palettes.

The Alchemist specializes in draining the life from her opponents to channel into her allies, equally capable of healing or inflicting damage and debuffs. As she deals damage, so does her healing output grow stronger, making her a flexible combatant. Her unique summon abilities, the Homunculus and the Lab Rat, are capable of providing additional support via either guarding her allies or ravaging her enemies.

"The Alchemist, despite her unsettling nature and abominable appendage, finds herself often saving the lives of her comrades. Her research and many experiments have rewarded her with great restorative abilities that can be further empowered through offensive action. In addition, she is accompanied by her lab-grown assistants that fiercely protect her, and whoever she calls an ally."[/i]

Her unique summon abilities, the Homunculus and the Lab Rat, are capable of providing additional support via either guarding her allies or ravaging her enemies.

notes.title: Week 3: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[h3][i]"A moment of valor shines brightest against a backdrop of despair."[/i][/h3]
We hope you all can remain Stalwart and Vigorous during this time and can find some solace through these mods!

[h3]Here are this weeks mods:[/h3]

[u][b]The Rightful Heiress[/b][/u] by kaxen

[i]Disgusted by the line of suitors claiming to be an improvement to her station in life, the Heiress returned to the cursed family estate with a fire for battle despite her own inexperience. Fortified by wine, she seeks to wade into the nightmare despite the hopelessness of the undertaking.

Heiress is a more offensive version of The Rightful Heir, boasting decent damage and mark proficiency, with few support abilities, while still having a signature ability of heir to collect and store more heirlooms while in a dungeon. Heirloom bonuses increase with the amount of heiresses in the party, and does not conflict with heir's ability, if you run both of them in same party.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2021307368

[u][b]The Clobber[/b][/u] by anonymous_koala and Sasiji

[i]Clobber is the Weald's guardian, who after years of watching his home be corrupted by the Hag's fungus, brigands, bloodsuckers and pretty much every enemy faction in the game at this point, decided he had enough and is ready to CRUSH the evildoers. Other things included in this mod are 12 new trinkets, a new district, a custom town event, and a new mechanic: chaining together rapid punches until Clobber is exhausted, through his "Punchout" skill![/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1867479147

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/792009307519457710/E930A4DDC77D826EA83EC6D0BC3FDC500769D978/[/img]



[h3]Thank you to the modders for their incredible creations! And thank you everyone for your continued support! [/h3]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/459110920094875659.png?v=1[/img]

If you would like to suggest mods for us to showcase, you can join our Discord here:

notes.title: Darkest Dungeon - Build #24353
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7434629/1bd1e9627ad69539498dabd1d19ca0ace6c02b3c.jpg[/img]
[b]Steam Build #24353[/b]
This update contains some significant changes to Endless Harvest brought about by feedback and observation.

It’s important to us that Endless Harvest is an exciting, tense experience. Some of the balance and structure in the first deployment make it possible to advance through what we consider an excessive amount of kills (1000+!) which results in a drawn out experience lacking some of the tension and excitement that we feel is vital. These changes have been made to try to keep the experience “punchy”, while still retaining that incentive and challenge of bettering your kill counts...without requiring a dozen or more hours for a single deep run. We hope that you find them to be good changes for the long term health of the mode, just as we do!

[h1]Introducing Color of Madness Endgame Conditions! [/h1]
[list]
[*]Once you have progressed beyond 200 Kills, the shimmering space-time of the corrupted Farmstead takes on an endgame condition, called a “Reflection.” These are mutators that increase the difficulty of the quest in different ways from that point onward.
[*][b]Unbearable Reflection:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Heroes: +33% Stress Dmg Received
[*]Heroes: -33% Stress Heal
[*]Monsters: +4 SPD[/list]
[*][b]Reflection of Decay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Heroes: -50% Healing
[*]Monsters: +15% PROT
[*]Monsters: +25% Stun Resist
[*]Monsters: +25% Debuff Resist[/list]
[*][b]Sanguine Reflection:[/b]
[list]
[*]Heroes: -8% Deathblow Resist
[*]Monsters: +7.5% Crit
[*]Monsters: +3 SPD[/list]
[*][b]Reflection Obscura:[/b]
[list]
[*]Heroes: -20% Stress Damage Received (a boon!)
[*]Heroes: -20% Healing
[*]Monsters: +10% PROT
[*]Monsters: +25% Damage[/list]
[/list]

These conditions stack on top of other Light conditions already present in whatever room you are present in the Farm or Space and Time.

[h1]Battle Limit Skill Refreshments in Endless Harvest:[/h1]
Battle Limited skills with battle-long durations were balanced for the normal game structure. In Endless Harvest, this resulted in them being overpowered because a given combat lasts much longer than a normal 4-monster combat.

Now in Endless Harvest, Battle Limited skills don’t refresh until the end of a given wave *group* instead of refreshing after each wave. This helps with the balance and creates some tension around when you should pop and lock those Leper combos.

Shard Dust, however, now carries the additional benefit of refreshing battle limited skills on an individual heroes. This is a zany idea that we think can be compelling and give you some additional tactical options. Of course, don’t hit that dust too much, or it will leave the hero worn out.

[h1]Changelist[/h1]
[b]Darkest Dungeon[/b]
[list]
[*]Japanese Localization added for Darkest Dungeon, The Crimson Court, and The Shieldbreaker. (The Color of Madness is coming).
[*]SOME SAY THAT CRITSMAS WENT TOO FAR. (Critsmas was when we increased crit %s AND added the OnCrit Buffs for each hero.) They are basically right. We have tweaked a number of crit values (skills, trinkets) down a bit to account for those OnCrit Buffs that were a late addition. Crits are still net+ from pre-Color of Madness release.
[*]Total Scouting chance can now be seen as a tooltip on the Quest Provision screen.
[*]Shambler loot increased
[*]Champion Bone Courtiers should drop their special Chalice more often now
[*]Moved Laudanum glossary entry to base game (from CC)
[*]Fix to crash when killing siren with controlled hero with reflect damage.
[*]Swinetaur brain improvements: hooked PIG SPEAR back up (it went missing!) and improved logic of Trot Retreat
[*]Added buff/debuff+ icons to quest length duration buffs/debuffs.
[*]Fix to double riposte overriding corpse crit clear.
[*]Fix to centered icons swapping sides.
[*]Carrion eater ACC++ on their main attacks
[*]Fix to alpha curio bug in battle.
[*]Leper crit tuning
[*]reworded Help strings referencing Retreat Flag to say "Retreat Icon (which looks like an "X")"
[*]Fix for quest generation that was creating too many quests in individual dungeons
[*]Town buffs and debuffs now use the new Buff+ and Debuff+ icons.
[*]Add ability to modify combat speed in the rules file.
[*]Fix to removing mortality debuff camping skills and the has had heart attack flag cleared.
[*]Riposte now won't trigger attack additional effects.
[*]Game now saves every time you sell a trinket.
[*]Fix to dead hero save load exploit.
[*]Fix to heart attack save load exploit.
[*]Mini-map will no longer auto center when scouting if you have the map_follow_party option set to off.
[*]Adjusted Torch Tooltip zones to account for when there is a light meter or not.
[*]Fixing loading issue where some spine_fx were missing (blood_splatter specifically)
[*]Fixing loading issue where some spine_fx were missing (blood_splatter specifically)
[*]Fix to swinatuar brains and trot retreat fixes.
[*]Fix to journal crash if you uninstall dlc.
[*]Added monster size check to unholly rally when corpses are disabled.
[*]Reduced active area of realm inventory by removing empty background.
[*]Arb/Musk fix to stagecoach chances for cases where user doesn't have Musketeer installed
[*]Fix to Virtue Hero avoidance in several monster attacks (brains)
[*]Added ability to specify clickable area of button
[*]Fix to shambler ambush bug
[*]Retroactively giving the In Such Haste achievement
[*]Fixed a bug that affected specific encounter bgs (ie. Fanatic and Shieldbreaker Nightmares)
[*]Fix to mashes being cleared from traps that spawn battles.
[*]Fixing pop up props associated with heros to be drawn with the hero instead of after the fact. 
[*]Fixes spawn monster effect rendering in front of summoner during summon. 
[*]Fixed retreat raid button from popping up during teleport
[*]Updated localization[/list]

[b]Crimson Court[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Adjusted Infestation [/b]- Players have consistently reported some dissatisfaction around the number of Bloodsucker spawns in dungeons during periods of High Infestation.  In order to better preserve each dungeon’s identity, High Infestation has had the following adjustments:
[list]
[*]Overall amount of hallway Bloodsucker encounters reduced, so as to not overwhelm a dungeon’s native population.
[*]Egg Sac curios appear at High Infestation, allowing players an opportunity to opt-in to a Bloodsucker fight and farm Blood and Invitations.[/list]
[*]Fixed a typo on CC Bleed Res Debuff 5 (ie. Champion monsters will now correctly apply bleed resistance debuffs to some of their attacks.)
[*]Fix to countess not showing skill names on transforms[/list]

[b]Shieldbreaker[/b]
[list]
[*]We have been concerned to see feedback that some players believe the Shieldbreaker flashback battles are never-ending and therefore the SB isn’t given as much value as she deserves. We’ve implemented a few things to help communicate that there are only 7 flashbacks and they only need passed once. (Not once per recruited SB.) 
[*]Added a tutorial for flashbacks.
[*]Flashbacks now have a 50% chance of happening on a given quest.
[*]The Shieldbreaker will now bark to warn the player of an impending nightmare before resting.
[*][b]Once the 7 flashbacks have been completed, all Shieldbreakers get a free restful sleep buff each time they camp![/b]
[*]Fix to controller exploit with flashbacks and ambush.
[*]Fix to being able to retreat from a flashback.
[*]Fix to immediately switching to room after not ambush camp and be visible sitting.[/list]

[b]The Color of Madness[/b]
[list]
[*]Reflections (see above)
[*]Change to Battle Limited skill refreshment while in Endless Harvest (see above)
[*]Wave spawned monsters now are placed more intelligently. (Front rank monsters will more reliably be placed in front; back rank monsters will more reliably be placed in back.)
[*]Revised length of post-Spire wavepools for new Endless Harvest rules. (Each wave group is shorter now.)
[*]Fix sorting of shard recruits.
[*]Remove raid buffs when dying and going to time and space.
[*]Remove plot quest required quirk heroes (shard recruits) from being calculated in hero level requirement for town events (vulf).
[*]Added refreshing of skills in curio rooms
[*]Abomination has an exception for his transformation
[*]Shard dust refreshes skills when used
[*]Remove roster limit quirk heroes ( shard recruits ) from being included in goals.
[*]Adding colour_grades to monster art files. In particular Galaxy and Spire.
[*]Geologic Study hall should no longer increase stacking of Tapestries and Antiquarian treasures
[*]Fix to torch settings persisting after death in time and space.
[*]Added Kill Count to Wave UI
[*]Lowered Thing roaming icon on quest select screen to reduce overlap on 4th position quest icons above it
[*]FIXED bug where once you've finished endless, game would reroll quests everytime you start it
[*]Remove map references from help menu in wave raid.
[*]Remove quest modifier buffs when you die and go to time and space.
[*]Thing debuffs don't apply if the attack misses
[*]Thing persists after retreat (you can't retreat to then roll a new encounter)
[*]Fixed "preferred" typo in game code. 
[*]Fix to skill Refresh pop text.
[*]Adjusted Shamblers encountered in the Farmstead to be equivalent to fighting at 0 light.
[*]Updated miller success/defeat strings
[*]Added controller support for nomad wagon and stagecoach for shard activities.
[*]Fixed bug w/ crystal overlays
[*]Sleeper's caretaker goal should now function correctly
[*]Increased Crystal Aberrations stun resist 400 from 200 (This is to prevent it from surviving until wave reinforcement, resulting in bugs)
[*]Fixed and issue around reloading a save during a turn where multiple Crystal Aberrations self-destructed resulting in one of the crystal surviving and causing an assert with wave reinforcements. [/list]

[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*]You can disable new Virtue loss at high stress and return to legacy system through an entry in Rules.json ("virtue_can_lose_from_stress" : false)
[*]Added tag based quirk evolution duration buff.
[*]Added a cure disease effect
[*]Add variable to disable buff description.
[*]Ability to have additional mashes based on quirk tags
[*]Fix to mod support bug where hp dot duration percent mods where not being applied.
[*]Added ability for multi target effects to have individual rolls on targets[/list]
